note: Learning pilot protocol, decision mode (Ümit #6225): arms control and records only; the records go at the start of `state` + a blank line (decision.rs state_with_block); context_gate server_invalid: a request the server refuses as too long is an invalid answer, the player goes on. Player: v3.db players.settings of 'KnowLine-2B-Gen1' (the league's frozen settings), plus context_gate. Limit 262,138 (SGLang context 262,144 - 6, refused above); prompt_max = the largest League 1 request alone, 23,122 tokens of its tokenizer (plain), so the note budget is limit - prompt_max - 1,500 = 237,516; the oldest whole games are dropped past it (logged). KnowLine caveat: its server reads a text request twice only up to 3,000 tokens; with any record in the state every request is read once (the league read most requests twice): a readout-regime change, for Ümit as REAX's D5.

players.note: PelaAI's KnowLine-2B-Gen1 (Hugging Face PelaAI/KnowLine-2B-Gen1 @ 53245d470a4ce316e32fd0d18c24e142c697f40b, Apache-2.0; Qwen3.5-2B with a one-epoch LoRA SFT merged into BF16, readout temperature 1.32 folded into the weights, score questions divided by temperatures.json) on our GPU through the repo's own serve_knowline.sh as the card serves it: SGLang 0.5.21 (torch 2.13.0+cu130, transformers 5.12.1) in BF16, --mem-fraction-static 0.85, --enable-fp32-lm-head, --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer, then the repo's knowline_server.py (served model name m, temperature 1, --temperatures temperatures.json, read twice up to 3,000 tokens). 255 options per request (the league's rule; longer lists split); never truncates: SGLang (no --allow-auto-truncate) refuses over its 262,144-token context. League 1's longest stored request (251 options) is 27,333 tokens of its tokenizer; none over.
